paper_info.title: Retrieval augmented generation evaluation in the era of large language models: A comprehensive survey
paper_info.authors: A Gan, H Yu, K Zhang, Q Liu, W Yan, Z Huang
paper_info.paper_abstract: Recent advancements in Retrieval-Augmented Gen- eration (RAG) have revolutionized natural language process- ing by integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with ex- ternal information retrieval, enabling accurate, up-to-date, and verifiable text generation across diverse applications. How- ever, evaluating RAG systems presents unique challenges due to their hybrid architecture that combines retrieval and gen- eration components, as well as their dependence on dynamic knowledge sources in the LLM era. In response, this paper provides a comprehensive survey of RAG evaluation meth- ods and frameworks, systematically reviewing traditional and emerging evaluation approaches, for system performance, fac- tual accuracy, safety, and computational efficiency in the LLM era. We also compile and categorize the RAG-specific datasets and evaluation frameworks, conducting a meta-analysis of evaluation practices in high-impact RAG research. To the best of our knowledge, this work represents the most com- prehensive survey for RAG evaluation, bridging traditional and LLM-driven methods, and serves as a critical resource for advancing RAG development.
paper_info.ai_abstract: 本文对大语言模型（LLM）时代下的检索增强生成（RAG）系统评估方法进行了全面综述。RAG通过将LLM与外部信息检索相结合，提升了生成内容的准确性、时效性与可验证性，但其混合架构和对动态知识源的依赖也给评估带来了独特挑战。作者系统梳理了面向RAG系统性能、事实准确性、安全性及计算效率的传统与新兴评估方法，区分了“内部评估”（针对检索与生成组件及其交互）和“外部评估”（关注系统整体表现与实际应用）。论文还整理并分类了RAG专用的数据集与评估框架，并对高影响力RAG研究中的评估实践进行了元分析。该综述旨在为研究人员提供一个连接传统与LLM驱动评估方法的综合性工具箱，以推动RAG系统的进一步发展。

paper_info.title: Engineering the RAG Stack: A Comprehensive Review of the Architecture and Trust Frameworks for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
paper_info.authors: D Wampler, D Nielson, A Seddighi
paper_info.paper_abstract: This article provides a comprehensive systematic literature review of academic studies, industrial applications, and real-world deploy- ments from 2018 to 2025, providing a practical guide and detailed overview of modern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architec- tures. RAG offers a modular approach for integrating external knowl- edge without increasing the capacity of the model as LLM systems ex- pand. Research and engineering practices have been fragmented as a result of the increasing diversity of RAG methodologies, which encom- passes a variety of fusion mechanisms, retrieval strategies, and orches- tration approaches. We provide quantitative assessment frameworks, analyze the implications for trust and alignment, and systematically consolidate existing RAG techniques into a unified taxonomy. This document is a practical framework for the deployment of resilient, se- cure, and domain-adaptable RAG systems, synthesizing insights from academic literature, industry reports, and technical implementation guides. It also functions as a technical reference. 1 arXiv:2601.05264v1 [cs.IR] 7 Nov 2025
paper_info.ai_abstract: 本文对2018至2025年间关于检索增强生成（RAG）系统的学术研究、工业应用和实际部署进行了系统性综述，旨在为RAG架构的设计与实施提供实用指南。RAG通过模块化方式将外部知识引入大语言模型（LLM），避免了因模型扩容带来的成本问题，并在信息时效性、可解释性和领域适应性方面展现出显著优势。然而，当前RAG方法在检索策略、融合机制和编排方式上高度碎片化，导致评估标准不统一、工程实践重复且缺乏系统性的信任框架。为此，作者提出了统一的RAG技术分类体系，构建了定量评估框架，并深入分析了RAG在可信性、对齐性和安全性方面的挑战。该文综合学术文献、行业报告与技术实现指南，为构建鲁棒、安全且可适配领域的RAG系统提供了全面的技术参考。

paper_info.title: SafeRAG: benchmarking security in retrieval-augmented generation of large language model
paper_info.authors: X Liang, S Niu, Z Li, S Zhang, H Wang
paper_info.paper_abstract: The indexing-retrieval-generation paradigm of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has been highly successful in solving knowledge- intensive tasks by integrating external knowl- edge into large language models (LLMs). How- ever, the incorporation of external and unveri- fied knowledge increases the vulnerability of LLMs because attackers can perform attack tasks by manipulating knowledge. In this paper, we introduce a benchmark named SafeRAG designed to evaluate the RAG security. First, we classify attack tasks into silver noise, inter- context conflict, soft ad, and white Denial-of- Service. Next, we construct RAG security eval- uation dataset (i.e., SafeRAG dataset) primar- ily manually for each task. We then utilize the SafeRAG dataset to simulate various attack sce- narios that RAG may encounter. Experiments conducted on 14 representative RAG compo- nents demonstrate that RAG exhibits signifi- cant vulnerability to all attack tasks and even the most apparent attack task can easily by- pass existing retrievers, filters, or advanced LLMs, resulting in the degradation of RAG service quality. Code is available at: https: //github.com/IAAR-Shanghai/SafeRAG.
paper_info.ai_abstract: 本文针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统在引入外部知识时面临的安全风险，提出了名为 SafeRAG 的安全评估基准。作者首先将 RAG 攻击任务划分为四类：银色噪声（silver noise）、上下文间冲突（inter-context conflict）、软广告（soft ad）和白名单拒绝服务（white Denial-of-Service），这些攻击能够绕过现有的检索器、过滤器或大语言模型（LLM）的安全机制。随后，研究团队主要通过人工方式构建了对应的 SafeRAG 安全评估数据集，并利用该数据集模拟多种真实攻击场景。在 14 个代表性 RAG 组件上的实验表明，当前 RAG 系统对上述所有攻击均表现出显著脆弱性，即使是显而易见的攻击也能轻易绕过现有防御措施，导致服务质量下降。该工作还提供了首个中文 RAG 安全基准，并开源了相关代码。
